question: Why did the error rate go up on 04 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of auth v2.14 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: auth v2.14 deployment introduced a new error (NullPointerException) in RequestHandler.serialize.
This error increased the error rate from 0.38% to 3.71%.
The error rate increase coincided with the deployment of auth v2.14.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of auth v2.14 likely caused the error rate increase.
why_chain: The error rate increase is concentrated in the service auth in region us-east.
This service is the only one affected by the deployment of auth v2.14.
The error rate increase happened shortly after the deployment.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of auth v2.14 may have caused the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a problem with the search service in eu-west.
ruled_out.reason: The search service deployment did not affect the error rate in us-east.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth in region us-east rose from 0.38% to 3.71% (+880%), with a change point at 2026-03-04T04:55:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.08).
At the same time, request volume for service auth in region us-east stayed about the same (490 per 5 min before, 564 per 5 min after, +15%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth in region us-east stayed about the same (90 ms before, 90 ms after, -0%).
Deployed auth v2.14 to us-east (auth, us-east; 8 min before the change; record R010)
High error rate on auth in us-east (auth, us-east; 5 min after the change; record R012)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.14) (auth, us-east; 3 min after the change; record R011)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.14) (auth, us-east; 22 min after the change; record R013)
Deployed search v8.0 to eu-west (search, eu-west; 9 min before the change; record R009)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (8 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the auth v2.14 deployment to us-east.
Implement a robust error handling mechanism in RequestHandler.serialize.
Monitor error rates closely after deployments and take corrective actions promptly.
